_doc: Desired public DNS for Lightbound's zones. Copy to ~/.config/argo/dns.json (0600) and run `argo dns check`.
No secrets live here: the Cloudflare token is only ever read from the Keychain by the gated `apply`.
Record fields (exactly one of value, values, stages, present, proxied):
value   one record; for TXT the record with the same prefix (v=spf1, v=DMARC1, google-site-verification) must equal it
values  the whole record set must match (MX, CAA)
stages  accepted values in order, the last is the target; `plan` prints the next one under Later
match   "tags" compares k=v; lists tag by tag; `require` lists tags that must stay (the existing DMARC rua)
present any value is fine (DKIM until the key exists); `prefix` narrows which TXT records count
proxied A/AAAA answers must be Cloudflare's edge (not pinned to addresses); a tailnet address is drift
dnssec true = a DS must exist at the parent (1.1.1.1 answers DS; the chain itself is not validated by Argo).
http = redirects checked over HTTPS with certificate verification on; a connection error is unverified, not drift.

zones.name: lightbound.space
zones.note: Main site: a Cloudflare Worker custom domain (apex and www proxied). Never sends or receives mail. Registrar is Spaceship, so DNSSEC needs the DS published there by hand.

records.note: created by the Worker custom domain; orange cloud

records.name: www
records.note: www redirects to the apex by a Redirect Rule; any DNS-only A to the tailnet here is drift

records.name: ops
records.note: operator console on the Mac's tailnet address; DNS-only, never proxied, created by ops-cert.sh
RFC 7208: this domain sends no mail

records.name: _dmarc
records.note: RFC 7489: reject anything claiming to be from @lightbound.space
null MX, RFC 7505: nobody can deliver mail here
RFC 8659: the CAs Cloudflare Universal SSL may use, plus Let's Encrypt for ops (lego DNS-01). security@ mailbox TBC

zones.name: lightbound.uk
zones.note: Mail (Google Workspace) and the long-lived name; second Cloudflare account (Cloudflare Registrar, DNSSEC automatic). The web side only redirects to lightbound.space.

records.note: Google Workspace; never enable Cloudflare Email Routing here
RFC 7208. Only one v=spf1 record. ~all now; -all once DMARC reports show every sender passing

records.name: google._domainkey
records.note: RFC 6376. Value TBC: Google Admin > Gmail > Authenticate email > Generate (2048-bit, selector google), then Start authentication after it resolves

records.name: _dmarc
records.note: RFC 7489. The existing rua (Cloudflare DMARC Management) is kept at every stage; move on only after 2-4 weeks of clean reports

records.name: _mta-sts
records.note: RFC 8461. id changes on every policy edit, so any value counts; the policy file at https://mta-sts.lightbound.uk/.well-known/mta-sts.txt is not checked yet (UNVERIFIED)

records.name: _smtp._tls
records.note: RFC 8460 TLS reporting. security@ mailbox TBC
AAAA 100:: proxied in Cloudflare is enough; the edge answers A and AAAA
